title: Men's HVAC – Did You Change the Filter? Tee

seo.title: Did You Change the Filter? – Funny HVAC Shirt
seo.description: A funny HVAC shirt for the tech who asks about the filter on every call. Soft 4.2 oz cotton tee, S–4XL, free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Did you change the filter? An HVAC shirt for the tech who asks it on every service call and gets the same blank stare back, worn on the truck, in the shop and at the Christmas party when someone's furnace comes up.

The print is a 1950s service-manual illustration of a wide-eyed, deadpan technician in a navy cap and a red short-sleeve work shirt, holding up a dusty pleated furnace filter in a cardboard frame with a cloud of dust puffing off it, a furnace cabinet with an orange door beside him. DID YOU CHANGE runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and THE FILTER? closes the line along the bottom.

Wear it to the job site, the shop or any family gathering where someone asks you about their AC, or give it to the tech in your life who has seen the filter and cannot unsee it. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes S–4XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Heather Forest, Steel Blue, Natural, Ash, Athletic Heather
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

What is the Did You Change the Filter? tee?
It is a men's HVAC graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a deadpan 1950s service tech holding up a filthy furnace filter, lettered DID YOU CHANGE THE FILTER? It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in lightweight 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays comfortable through a hot attic and a long day.

How do I wash it so the print lasts?
Wash your Did You Change the Filter? tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the cream, mustard, navy and red inks stay crisp through every job and every wash.

Is it a good gift for an HVAC tech?
Yes. At $24.99 from Graphic Tees Co. it suits the tech, the apprentice or the shop owner, and wives and kids buy it for birthdays and Christmas. It is a safe joke for anyone who has fielded the same filter question a hundred times. Your first size exchange is free.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Did You Change the Filter? tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and your first size exchange is free.

What colors does it come in?
Graphic Tees Co. offers it in Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Heather Forest and Steel Blue with cream and mustard ink, and in Natural, Ash and Athletic Heather with navy and red ink so every word stays easy to read. Sizes run S through 4XL, 56 options in all.

How does it fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in S through 4XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a looser one.
